# vroot

> vroot is a single Bash script that turns a flag into an isolated Linux root
> shell: `vroot -python` gives you a root shell with Python, built from a
> single-file squashfs image, launched with bubblewrap and overlayfs. No daemon,
> no sudo, no image build step. Built so that agents and scripts can obtain a
> toolchain on demand and throw it away.

Version: 2.2.x · License: MIT · Language: Bash (single file) · Host: Linux

## Install

    curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gairxx/vroot/main/install.sh | sh

Installs the launcher plus its recipe catalogue under `~/.local` (no sudo).
Or clone and run the script directly: `bash vroot/vroot -python`.

Requirements: Linux with unprivileged user namespaces, `bubblewrap`,
`util-linux`, `squashfs-tools`, `curl`. `docker` only for Debian-based flags.

## Minimal workflow

    vroot build -python --json        # {"env":"/…/python-84d0423ed3.sqfs","cached":false}
    vroot -python -- python3 -c 'print(1)'   # run one command, exit
    vroot -python work                # persistent named sandbox
    vroot save work out.vroot         # pack it into one portable image
    vroot out.vroot -- cat /root/f    # boot that image anywhere

## Machine interface

- `--json` on `build`, `ls`, `envs`, `info`. JSON goes to stdout; logs go to stderr.
- Exit status is meaningful: unknown flag → 1; `-- CMD` forwards CMD's exit status.
- Env image names are content-addressed (`<slug>-<10-hex>.sqfs`), so the same
  recipe set always resolves to the same file.
- Concurrent builds/launches of the same env are serialised by a lock directory;
  cache unpacking is atomic.
- `vroot -bogus` prints one `err …` line to stderr and exits 1 (no shell noise).

## Docs

- [Agent contract (canonical)](https://github.com/gairxx/vroot/blob/main/docs/AGENTS.md): the full rules, JSON shapes, parallelism and fork semantics.
- [Full plain-text reference](https://gairxx.github.io/vroot/llms-full.txt): everything in one file, no JavaScript.
- [Human documentation](https://gairxx.github.io/vroot/docs.html): usage, options, persistence, FAQ.
- [Flag catalog](https://gairxx.github.io/vroot/flags.html): all 42 environments with aliases and base.
- [flags.json](https://gairxx.github.io/vroot/flags.json): the same catalog as machine-readable JSON.
- [Recipes](https://gairxx.github.io/vroot/recipes.html): how flags map to recipes, and how to add your own.
- [README](https://github.com/gairxx/vroot/blob/main/README.md): project overview and install matrix.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md at this site](https://gairxx.github.io/vroot/AGENTS.md): short pointer file for agents that look for it at the root.
- [Source](https://github.com/gairxx/vroot): the whole tool is one readable script.
